answer: Escrow bonds and a referral graph stop hollow identities. Each agent locks 40 POA in escrow and publishes referral links, so the graph mirrors real ties. Hollow shells with no history stand out at once. Peers may dispute a suspect; confirmed fraud slashes the bond and half the referrer's. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA; each fake earns under 5 POA. An honest agent pays once, keeps full rewards, and its ferrous bond returns after 20 epochs.
